description: This file defines a class implementing the 'Sign' mathematical function within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functionality to determine the sign of a number or array of numbers.

classes.name: Sign
classes.description: Class to calculate the sign of a number, returning 1 for positive, 0 for zero, and -1 for negative. Supports array inputs.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Determines the sign of a provided number or array of numbers, handling validation and error messaging.
